entries.text_template:
Locate the object described below in the image and return its bounding box.
Description: {referring_expression}
Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"bbox": [x, y, w, h]} where (x, y) is the top-left corner and (w, h) are the width and height in absolute pixels.
If the object is not present in the image, respond with exactly: NOT_PRESENT
entries.notes: Single shared prompted-bbox template for all five models. Coordinates are PROMPT-INDUCED (Cosmos here is prompt-induced, never native bbox). Only {referring_expression} varies across L1-L4 tiers and paraphrases (E2/RQ3); the format instruction stays fixed.
